e.title: Assurance Toto 法国车险数字孪生：一个由 8 个智能体代运营、CEO 保留高风险决定的模拟保险公司——每个动作都是密码学签名事件，全部可追溯靠一条哈希链追加审计日志与端到端的 correlation_id
e.title_en: Assurance Toto, a digital twin of a French car insurer: a simulated insurer run by eight agents with the CEO retaining high-stakes decisions, where every action is a cryptographically signed event and full traceability rests on a hash-chained append-only audit log plus an end-to-end correlation_id
e.title_hk: Assurance Toto 法國車險數字孿生：一個由 8 個智能體代運營、CEO 保留高風險決定的模擬保險公司——每個動作都是密碼學簽名事件，全部可追溯靠一條哈希鏈追加審計日誌與端到端的 correlation_id
e.summary: 一个法国车险公司的「数字孪生」：它模拟一家 50 人的数字化车险公司并以多智能体组织的方式运行——人类 CEO 通过一个基于 Nostr 的工作台与一个精简驾驶舱监督，8 个业务智能体（销售、核保、理赔与诉讼、财务、客服、市场、合规、编排）在本地大模型上执行工作流；其治理机制逐字为「每个动作都是密码学签名事件；每一个高风险决定（超过阈值的理赔结案、定价例外、杀死开关）都需要 CEO 明确批准」，全部可追溯性靠「一条哈希链式追加审计日志与一个端到端的 correlation_id」；其定位声明把边界写得很直白——「这是一个可在沙箱运行的、面向合规的**演示器**，它**没有**取得 ACPR／RGPD 认证，且**不处理真实个人数据**（100% 合成 Faker 数据）」；仓库以 Apache-2.0 发布并含一条 CI 工作流，其智能体运行时含一个隐私匿名化模块
e.summary_hk: 一個法國車險公司的「數字孿生」：它模擬一家 50 人的數字化車險公司並以多智能體組織的方式運行——人類 CEO 通過一個基於 Nostr 的工作台與一個精簡駕駛艙監督，8 個業務智能體（銷售、核保、理賠與訴訟、財務、客服、市場、合規、編排）在本地大模型上執行工作流；其治理機制逐字為「每個動作都是密碼學簽名事件；每一個高風險決定（超過閾值的理賠結案、定價例外、殺死開關）都需要 CEO 明確批准」，全部可追溯性靠「一條哈希鏈式追加審計日誌與一個端到端的 correlation_id」；其定位聲明把邊界寫得很直白——「這是一個可在沙箱運行的、面向合規的**演示器**，它**沒有**取得 ACPR／RGPD 認證，且**不處理真實個人數據**（100% 合成 Faker 數據）」；倉庫以 Apache-2.0 發布並含一條 CI 工作流，其智能體運行時含一個隱私匿名化模組
e.summary_en: A "digital twin" of a French car insurance company: it simulates a fifty-employee digital car insurer running as a multi-agent organisation, where the human CEO supervises through a Nostr-based workspace and a lean cockpit while eight business agents (sales, underwriting, claims and litigation, finance, support, marketing, compliance and orchestration) execute workflows on a local model; its governance mechanism reads verbatim that every action is a cryptographically signed event and that every high-stakes decision — claim settlement above a threshold, pricing exceptions, the kill-switch — requires explicit CEO approval, with full traceability resting on a hash-chained append-only audit log and an end-to-end correlation_id; its positioning statement states the boundary plainly, calling itself a sandbox-ready, compliance-oriented demonstrator that is not ACPR or GDPR certified and that does not process real personal data, using one hundred percent synthetic Faker data; the repository is released under Apache-2.0 with a CI workflow, and its agent runtime includes a privacy anonymisation module
e.body:
**assurance-toto-twin**（Assurance Toto，仓库 `leosand/assurance-toto`）**是一个法国车险公司的「数字孪生」**：**实测 ★0、主语言 TypeScript、仓库体量 51,865 KB、创建于 2026-07-24、最后推送 2026-09-07**（**⚠️ 本条元数据来自**搜索 API**，因**核心 API 配额在本轮用尽****——**见标注 ①**）；**⭐ 许可实测为 **Apache-2.0**，且 `LICENSE` 经 tarball 实测存在**（**本会话少见的一处**许可齐备****）；**README 已获取（本次读取其开篇）**；**仓库实测共 264 个条目**。**其自述逐字为**：**「A commercial-grade **digital twin** of a French car insurance company operated by a CEO assisted by a **fleet of autonomous AI agents** — with **mandatory human control, full cryptographic traceability, and compliance-oriented by design**.」**。本条目属于本轮主题**「每个值都要指回它的来源」**中的**第三种，也是四条里**溯源颗粒度落在「动作」上**的一条**——**它记录的不是一个字段或一个单元格的来处，**而是**每一个动作的来处**。

可核实信息（**均 README 实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **其运行规模的描述逐字且具体，含人数、智能体数与模型**——**逐字为**：**「Assurance Toto simulates a **50-employee digital car insurer** run as a multi-agent organization:」**；**「A **CEO (human)** supervises via a **Nostr-based workspace (Buzz)** and a lean CEO cockpit.」**；**「**8 business agents**（**sales, underwriting, claims & litigation, finance, support, marketing, compliance, orchestration**）execute workflows on a **local LLM (Ollama, `gemma4:e4b`)**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① **人类 CEO 与 8 个智能体的分工**被写成了一个组织的形态**（**而不是一个「AI 助手」**）；**② **本地大模型**（**Ollama**）**——**⭐ 与其「零付费 API 依赖」的主张一致**；**③ **合规（compliance）是 8 个智能体之一**（**⭐ 即**合规被建模成一个**有自己的职能的部门**，而不是散在各处的检查项**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **其治理机制逐字，且它是本条对溯源主题的核心贡献**——**逐字为**：**「**Every action is a cryptographically signed event**; **every high-stakes decision (claim settlement above a threshold, pricing exceptions, kill-switch) requires explicit CEO approval.**」**；**「Full traceability via a **hash-chained append-only audit log** and an **end-to-end `correlation_id`**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① **每个动作都签名**（**即**动作本身可被指认**）；**② **三类高风险决定被点名**（**超过阈值的理赔结案、定价例外、杀死开关**）**——**⭐ 而这三类恰好对应本行最敏感的三件事：赔、价、停****；**③ **哈希链式追加审计日志**（**⭐ 与第 336 轮 [[blueeconomy-marine-insurance]] 的「追加式哈希链审计，触发器拒绝 UPDATE/DELETE」是同一机制**）；**④ **端到端的 `correlation_id`**（**⭐ 即**一次业务请求穿过多个智能体与多个部门之后，其全部动作仍可被串回同一条线上****）**⭐⭐⭐ **第 ④ 点对本轮主题尤其重要**：**在**多智能体**系统里，「这个结果是谁做出来的」比在单进程系统里难得多**，**而 `correlation_id` 是把这句话变成可回答问题的机制****。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **其定位声明逐字，且它在一段里同时否掉两件事**——**逐字为**：**「> ⚠️ **Honest positioning** : this is a **sandbox-ready, compliance-oriented demonstrator**. It is **not ACPR/RGPD-certified** and **does not process real personal data (100 % synthetic Faker data)**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① **自称「演示器」而不是产品**；**② **明确**没有取得 ACPR／RGPD 认证****（**⭐ ACPR 是法国审慎监管与处置局、RGPD 是欧盟通用数据保护条例**——**即**它点名了两个具体的、与法国车险最相关的监管／合规框架，并说自己都没拿到**）；**③ **明确**不处理真实个人数据、100% 合成数据****（**⭐ 与第 336 轮 [[claims-integrity-investigator]] 的「Synthetic, obviously fictional data only」、[[inforsight]] 的「fictional」同族**）**⭐⭐⭐ **对做智能体保险应用的同学，这一段是**可直接照搬的定位写法**：**它不掩饰自己是什么，**并且把两个最容易被人误以为已经满足的门槛**逐一点名否掉****。**④ ⭐⭐ **其商业定位的表述也逐字，但它把「卖点」与「不是什么」分开写**——**逐字为**：**「It is a **sellable demo** for French/EU auto insurers, brokers, insurtechs and transformation consultancies — designed to prove : reduced cost per claim, faster underwriting, shorter response time, **human control on high-risk decisions**, **sovereign self-hosted deployment**, and **zero paid API dependency**.」**⭐⭐ **即**它列了五项要证明的东西，**其中两项是**约束**而不是**收益****（**人类对高风险决定的控制、主权自托管部署**）——**⭐ 对本行读者，这是一个**把「合规与主权」当作卖点而不是成本**的样本**（**⚠️ 本词条**未核实**这五项中任何一项是否真的被证明**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **实测其智能体运行时的结构，且其中一个模块值得单独记**——**实测 `agents/_runtime/` 下含**：**`Dockerfile`、`README.md`、`package-lock.json`、`package.json`，以及 `src/` 下** `bridge/client.ts`、`composition.ts`、`config.ts`、`db/client.ts`、`index.ts`、`llm/ollama.ts`、`logger.ts`、**`privacy/anonymize.ts`**、`runtime/agent.ts`**⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① **`llm/ollama.ts`**——**⭐ 即**模型接口是针对**本地 Ollama** 写的**，**与其「零付费 API 依赖」一致**；**② ⭐ **`privacy/anonymize.ts`**——**⭐ 即**隐私匿名化是运行时的**一个独立模块**，**而不是一句声明**（**⭐ 这与第 ③ 点的「不处理真实个人数据」配套：**合成数据是一层，**匿名化模块是另一层**）；**③ **`logger.ts` 与 `bridge/client.ts` 分开**——**⭐ 即**日志与外部桥接各有其位**（**⚠️ 本词条**未读任何源码**，**故**不主张这些模块的功能如其名**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **其技术栈逐字（以徽章形式列出）**：**TypeScript（标注为 Strict）**、**Nostr（协议）**、**Buzz by Block（驾驶舱）**、**Ollama（本地模型）**、**PostgreSQL 16**、**Docker Compose（部署）**⭐⭐ **其中三处值得记**：**① **TypeScript 标注为 Strict**（**即**开了严格模式**）；**② **PostgreSQL 16** 作为数据库**（**与第 336 轮 [[blueeconomy-marine-insurance]] 同源：**把不变式放在数据库层**）；**③ **Docker Compose 部署 + 本地模型**（**⭐ 即**「主权自托管」在技术栈上是有落点的**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **其 README 另有两条徽章需要如实指出**：**一条逐字为**「**Tests: 75**」（**其图片地址形如 `img.shields.io/badge/tests-75%20green-…`**）**，**另一条逐字为**「**API: 0 paid dependency**」****⭐⭐ **⚠️ 本词条须指出：**「Tests: 75 green」是一张**静态徽章****（**shields.io 的 `/badge/` 静态接口**）**——**⭐ 即**它不测量任何东西，**无论测试实际是否通过都会显示为绿色****（**⚠️ 本次**未查其 CI 的实际运行结果**，**故**既不主张其 75 个测试通过，也不主张其未通过**）**；**⭐ 这与第 337 轮 [[inforsight]] 的「CI passing」静态徽章是**同一类问题**，**故本词条在此同样如实标注**（**⚠️ 本词条**不推断**作者是否有意如此**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **实测其仓库另含一条 CI 工作流**：**`.github/workflows/ci.yml`**（**实测存在**）**——**⭐ 即**它**确实有** CI 配置**，**故**那张静态徽章的问题**不是「没有 CI」，而是「徽章不反映 CI」****。**⑨ ⭐ 可与本站治理、开源核心系统与合规智能体条目并读**：[[insurance-governance]]、[[blueeconomy-marine-insurance]]、[[titanium-insurance-core]]、[[openimis]]、[[quorumforge]]、[[cloud-itonami-isic-6520]]、[[claims-integrity-investigator]]、[[insurance-ai-regulation-mcp]]、[[acpr]]、[[institut-des-actuaires]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️ **元数据来源需要说明**：**核心 API 配额在本轮用尽**，**故 ★数（0）、许可（Apache-2.0）、语言（TypeScript）、体量（51,865 KB）与创建／推送日期（2026-07-24／2026-09-07）来自**搜索 API****；**⚠️ **未能取得其 fork 数与 topics****（**⚠️ 属**未核实**项，**而**不是**「无 topics」**）；**⭐ README 的**字节数本次未测量**（**只读取了开篇**），**故本词条**不给其 README 规模数字****。**② ⚠️⚠️ **本次**只读了 README 的开篇与「它是什么」「AI 运营的保险组织」「人类控制与治理」各节的**开头****——**⭐ 即**本次**未通读其 README 全文**，**也未读其 `docs/`（若有）下任何内容****；**故**本词条所述内容限于上述各节**——**这是本条目最需要后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **未读任何源码、未运行任何命令、未做任何密码学核实****——**⚠️ 故**「每个动作都是密码学签名事件」「哈希链式追加审计日志」「端到端 `correlation_id`」「三类高风险决定需 CEO 明示批准」四项**全部只记录为 README 如此声明****；**⭐ 本词条**已实测的只是**相关文件与目录确实存在****（**`LICENSE`、`.github/workflows/ci.yml`、`agents/_runtime/` 及其下九个源文件含 `privacy/anonymize.ts` 与 `llm/ollama.ts`**）**——**⚠️ 但**文件存在不等于其中的机制如文档所述**；**⭐ 尤其**未核实**其签名与哈希链的密码学实现是否正确或安全****（**本词条**不建议**任何人据此实现生产系统**）。**④ ⚠️⚠️ **未核实**其「8 个智能体」是否确实都在运行、各自的权限如何、以及**杀死开关**是否真的可用**；**⚠️ 本次**未运行其 Docker Compose、未读其配置、未做任何实际调用****。**⑤ ⚠️⭐ **未核实**其「100% 合成 Faker 数据」这一声明**——**⚠️ 本次**未读任何数据文件或数据生成代码****；**⭐ 而这一点直接关系到它是否可以被安全地公开演示**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**其数据确实全部为合成**）。**⑥ ⚠️⭐ **未核实**其「不是 ACPR／RGPD 认证」这一否定的反面**——**⭐ 即**本词条**不主张**它**未**满足任何具体监管要求**（**⚠️ 本次**未查 ACPR 或 RGPD 的任何条款**）；**⚠️ 只记录它自己声明没有认证**。**⑦ ⚠️ **本次核实的是**仓库元数据（**来自搜索 API**）、README 的开篇与上述各节开头、以及仓库全部 264 个条目的文件清单**；⭐⭐ **但**未克隆、未安装 Docker／Node／PostgreSQL、未运行任何命令、未启动任何智能体、**未读任何源码、未读其 `agents/_runtime/README.md`、未读 `.github/workflows/ci.yml` 的内容、未访问其任何界面或 Nostr 工作台****。**⑧ ⚠️ **未核实**其与 ACPR、任何法国或欧盟监管机构、任何保险公司或任何咨询机构的关系**；**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**它已被任何机构采用、已售出、已试点或已产生任何实际的保险运营效果**（**⭐ 其自述用词为「sellable demo」与「demonstrator」，**即**定位是演示**）。**⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ **不主张**其「数字孪生」这一定性在精算或运营意义上成立**——**⚠️ 本次**未核实**其是否复现了任何真实车险公司的流程、口径或数据分布**；**⭐ 对本行读者，一个「数字孪生」若不在业务口径上对应现实，**则其演示价值主要在**架构与治理**，而不在**业务结论****（**⚠️ 本词条据此建议按其治理设计而非其业务输出阅读本项目**）。**⑩ ⭐ ⚠️ **不主张**其技术选择（本地模型、Nostr 工作台、Docker Compose）在任何意义上优于云端方案**——**只记录其自述理由（主权自托管、零付费 API 依赖）**。**⑪ ⭐ ⚠️ **未核实**其是否处理任何真实的客户数据或是否涉及任何真实保单**（**其自述为纯合成数据，**本词条只记录该声明**）。**⑫ ⭐ ★0、创建于 2026-07-24、推送于 2026-09-07**，**关注度极低**，**不主张其成熟度、正确性或已被采用**；**⑬ ⭐ 许可为 **Apache-2.0** 且 `LICENSE` 实测存在**——**⭐ 与本轮其他三条对照：**[[application-fill-provenance]]、[[quotelens-provenance]] 与 [[bill-auditor-india]] 实测**均无许可文件****；**⑭ **README 为英语**（**其内容涉及法国市场，**⚠️ 本次未核实是否有法语版本**）。**核实说明**：核心 API 于本轮返回 rate limit 错误，**故元数据改用**搜索 API** 的值，且未能取得 fork 数与 topics**；README 经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 实测读取开篇与上述各节开头；**仓库全部 264 个条目**经下载 `codeload.github.com` tarball 后以 `tar tz` 列出核对（**用于确认 `LICENSE`、`.github/workflows/ci.yml` 与 `agents/_runtime/` 下九个源文件均存在**）；**未克隆、未安装 Docker／Node／PostgreSQL、未运行任何命令、未启动任何智能体、未读任何源码、未做任何密码学核实、未做任何网络或 Nostr 请求**。

**assurance-toto-twin**（Assurance Toto，倉庫 `leosand/assurance-toto`）**是一個法國車險公司的「數字孿生」**：**實測 ★0、主語言 TypeScript、體量 51,865 KB、創建於 2026-07-24、最後推送 2026-09-07**（**⚠️ 本條元數據來自**搜索 API**，因**核心 API 配額在本輪用盡****）；**⭐ 許可實測為 **Apache-2.0**，且 `LICENSE` 經 tarball 實測存在****；**倉庫實測共 264 個條目**。**其自述逐字為**：**「A commercial-grade **digital twin** of a French car insurance company operated by a CEO assisted by a **fleet of autonomous AI agents** — with **mandatory human control, full cryptographic traceability, and compliance-oriented by design**.」**。本條目屬本輪主題**「每個值都要指回它的來源」**中的**第三種，也是四條裡**溯源顆粒度落在「動作」上**的一條****。

可核實資訊（**均 README 實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **其運行規模的描述逐字且具體，含人數、智能體數與模型**：**「Assurance Toto simulates a **50-employee digital car insurer** run as a multi-agent organization:」**；**「A **CEO (human)** supervises via a **Nostr-based workspace (Buzz)** and a lean CEO cockpit.」**；**「**8 business agents**（**sales, underwriting, claims & litigation, finance, support, marketing, compliance, orchestration**）execute workflows on a **local LLM (Ollama, `gemma4:e4b`)**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **三處值得記**：**① 人類 CEO 與 8 個智能體的分工被寫成了一個組織的形態**；**② **本地大模型（Ollama）**與其「零付費 API 依賴」一致**；**③ **合規是 8 個智能體之一****（**⭐ 即**合規被建模成一個有自己職能的部門，而不是散在各處的檢查項**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **其治理機制逐字，且它是本條對溯源主題的核心貢獻**：**「**Every action is a cryptographically signed event**; **every high-stakes decision (claim settlement above a threshold, pricing exceptions, kill-switch) requires explicit CEO approval.**」**；**「Full traceability via a **hash-chained append-only audit log** and an **end-to-end `correlation_id`**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四處值得記**：**① **每個動作都簽名**；**② **三類高風險決定被點名（超過閾值的理賠結案、定價例外、殺死開關）——**⭐ 恰好對應本行最敏感的三件事：賠、價、停****；**③ **哈希鏈式追加審計日誌**（**與第 336 輪 [[blueeconomy-marine-insurance]] 的「追加式哈希鏈審計，觸發器拒絕 UPDATE/DELETE」是同一機制**）；**④ **端到端的 `correlation_id`**（**⭐ 即**一次業務請求穿過多個智能體與多個部門之後，其全部動作仍可被串回同一條線上****）**⭐⭐⭐ **第 ④ 點對本輪主題尤其重要**：**在**多智能體**系統裡「這個結果是誰做出來的」比在單進程系統裡難得多，**而 `correlation_id` 是把這句話變成可回答問題的機制****。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **其定位聲明逐字，且它在一段裡同時否掉兩件事**：**「> ⚠️ **Honest positioning** : this is a **sandbox-ready, compliance-oriented demonstrator**. It is **not ACPR/RGPD-certified** and **does not process real personal data (100 % synthetic Faker data)**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **三處**：**① 自稱「演示器」而不是產品**；**② **明確沒有取得 ACPR／RGPD 認證****（**⭐ ACPR 是法國審慎監管與處置局、RGPD 是歐盟通用數據保護條例——即它點名了兩個與法國車險最相關的監管／合規框架並說自己都沒拿到**）；**③ **明確不處理真實個人數據、100% 合成數據****（**與第 336 輪 claims-integrity-investigator 的 Synthetic, obviously fictional data only、inforsight 的 fictional 同族**）**⭐⭐⭐ **對做智能體保險應用的同學，這一段是可直接照搬的定位寫法：**它不掩飾自己是什麼，並把兩個最容易被人誤以為已經滿足的門檻逐一點名否掉****。**④ ⭐⭐ **其商業定位的表述逐字，但它把「賣點」與「不是什麼」分開寫**：**「It is a **sellable demo** for French/EU auto insurers, brokers, insurtechs and transformation consultancies — designed to prove : reduced cost per claim, faster underwriting, shorter response time, **human control on high-risk decisions**, **sovereign self-hosted deployment**, and **zero paid API dependency**.」**⭐⭐ **即**它列了五項要證明的東西，其中兩項是**約束**而不是**收益****（**人類對高風險決定的控制、主權自託管部署**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **實測其智能體運行時的結構**：**`agents/_runtime/` 下含 `Dockerfile`、`README.md`、`package-lock.json`、`package.json`，以及 `src/` 下 `bridge/client.ts`、`composition.ts`、`config.ts`、`db/client.ts`、`index.ts`、`llm/ollama.ts`、`logger.ts`、**`privacy/anonymize.ts`**、`runtime/agent.ts`**⭐⭐ **三處**：**① **`llm/ollama.ts`**（模型接口是針對本地 Ollama 寫的）；**② ⭐ **`privacy/anonymize.ts`**——**⭐ 即**隱私匿名化是運行時的一個獨立模組，而不是一句聲明****（**與第 ③ 點的「不處理真實個人數據」配套：合成數據是一層，匿名化模組是另一層**）；**③ **`logger.ts` 與 `bridge/client.ts` 分開**（**未讀任何源碼，故不主張這些模組的功能如其名**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **其技術棧逐字（以徽章形式列出）**：**TypeScript（標註為 Strict）／Nostr（協議）／Buzz by Block（駕駛艙）／Ollama（本地模型）／PostgreSQL 16／Docker Compose（部署）**⭐⭐ **其中三處**：**① TypeScript 標註為 Strict**；**② **PostgreSQL 16 作為數據庫**（與第 336 輪 blueeconomy-marine-insurance 同源：把不變式放在數據庫層）；**③ **Docker Compose 部署加本地模型**（「主權自託管」在技術棧上是有落點的）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **其 README 另有兩條徽章需要如實指出**：**「**Tests: 75**」（圖片地址形如 `img.shields.io/badge/tests-75%20green-…`）與 **「**API: 0 paid dependency**」****⭐⭐ **⚠️ 須指出：**「Tests: 75 green」是一張**靜態徽章****——**⭐ 即**它不測量任何東西，無論測試實際是否通過都會顯示為綠色****（**⚠️ 本次**未查其 CI 的實際運行結果**，**故**既不主張其 75 個測試通過，也不主張其未通過**）**；**⭐ 這與第 337 輪 [[inforsight]] 的「CI passing」靜態徽章是**同一類問題****（**不推斷作者是否有意如此**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **實測其倉庫另含一條 CI 工作流**：**`.github/workflows/ci.yml`**——**⭐ 即**它**確實有** CI 配置，**故**那張靜態徽章的問題**不是「沒有 CI」，而是「徽章不反映 CI」****。**⑨ ⭐ 可與 [[insurance-governance]]、[[blueeconomy-marine-insurance]]、[[titanium-insurance-core]]、[[openimis]]、[[quorumforge]]、[[cloud-itonami-isic-6520]]、[[claims-integrity-investigator]]、[[insurance-ai-regulation-mcp]]、[[acpr]]、[[institut-des-actuaires]] 並讀**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① ⚠️⚠️ **元數據來源需要說明**：**核心 API 配額在本輪用盡**，**故 ★數（0）、許可（Apache-2.0）、語言（TypeScript）、體量（51,865 KB）與創建／推送日期（2026-07-24／2026-09-07）來自**搜索 API****；**⚠️ **未取得 fork 數與 topics****（**⚠️ 屬**未核實**項，而**不是**「無 topics」**）；**⭐ README 的**位元組數本次未測量**（**只讀取了開篇**），**故不給其 README 規模數字****。**② ⚠️⚠️ **本次**只讀了 README 的開篇與「它是什麼」「AI 運營的保險組織」「人類控制與治理」各節的**開頭****——**⭐ 即**未通讀其 README 全文，**也未讀其 `docs/`（若有）下任何內容****；**故**本詞條所述內容限於上述各節**——**這是本條目最需要後續核實的一處**。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **未讀任何源碼、未運行任何命令、未做任何密碼學核實****——**⚠️ 故**「每個動作都是密碼學簽名事件」「哈希鏈式追加審計日誌」「端到端 `correlation_id`」「三類高風險決定需 CEO 明示批准」四項**全部只記錄為 README 如此聲明****；**⭐ 已實測的只是**相關文件與目錄確實存在****（**`LICENSE`、`.github/workflows/ci.yml`、`agents/_runtime/` 及其下九個源文件含 `privacy/anonymize.ts` 與 `llm/ollama.ts`**）**——**⚠️ 但**文件存在不等於其中的機制如文檔所述**；**⭐ 尤其**未核實**其簽名與哈希鏈的密碼學實現是否正確或安全****（**不建議**任何人據此實現生產系統**）。**④ ⚠️⚠️ **未核實**其「8 個智能體」是否確實都在運行、各自權限如何、以及**殺死開關**是否真的可用**；**本次**未運行其 Docker Compose、未讀其配置、未做任何實際調用****。**⑤ ⚠️⭐ **未核實**其「100% 合成 Faker 數據」這一聲明**（**未讀任何數據文件或數據生成代碼**）；**⭐ 而這一點直接關係到它是否可以被安全地公開演示****。**⑥ ⚠️⭐ **未核實**其「不是 ACPR／RGPD 認證」這一否定的反面**——**⭐ 即**不主張**它**未**滿足任何具體監管要求**（**本次**未查 ACPR 或 RGPD 的任何條款**）。**⑦ ⚠️ **本次核實到**倉庫元數據（**來自搜索 API**）、README 的開篇與上述各節開頭、以及全部 264 個條目的文件清單**；⭐⭐ **但**未克隆、未安裝 Docker／Node／PostgreSQL、未運行任何命令、未啟動任何智能體、**未讀任何源碼、未讀 `agents/_runtime/README.md`、未讀 `.github/workflows/ci.yml` 的內容、未訪問其任何界面或 Nostr 工作台****。**⑧ ⚠️ **未核實**其與 ACPR、任何法國或歐盟監管機構、任何保險公司或任何諮詢機構的關係**；**不主張**它已被任何機構採用、已售出、已試點或已產生任何實際的保險運營效果**（**其自述用詞為 sellable demo 與 demonstrator**）。**⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ **不主張**其「數字孿生」這一定性在精算或運營意義上成立**（**未核實**其是否復現了任何真實車險公司的流程、口徑或數據分佈**）；**⭐ 建議按其治理設計而非其業務輸出閱讀本項目****。**⑩ ⭐ ⚠️ **不主張**其技術選擇在任何意義上優於雲端方案**。**⑪ ⭐ ⚠️ **未核實**其是否處理任何真實的客戶數據或涉及任何真實保單**。**⑫ ⭐ ★0、創建於 2026-07-24、推送於 2026-09-07**，**不主張其成熟度／正確性／已被採用**；**⑬ ⭐ 許可為 **Apache-2.0** 且 `LICENSE` 實測存在**——**⭐ 與本輪其他三條對照：[[application-fill-provenance]]、[[quotelens-provenance]] 與 [[bill-auditor-india]] 實測**均無許可文件****；**⑭ **README 為英語**（**其內容涉及法國市場，本次未核實是否有法語版本**）。**核實說明**：核心 API 於本輪返回 rate limit 錯誤，**故元數據改用**搜索 API** 的值，且未能取得 fork 數與 topics**；README 經 raw 實測讀取開篇與上述各節開頭；**全部 264 個條目**經下載 tarball 後以 `tar tz` 列出核對；**未克隆、未安裝 Docker／Node／PostgreSQL、未運行任何命令、未啟動任何智能體、未讀任何源碼、未做任何密碼學核實、未做任何網絡或 Nostr 請求**。

**assurance-toto-twin** (Assurance Toto, repository `leosand/assurance-toto`) **is a "digital twin" of a French car insurance company**: **measured ★0, TypeScript as the primary language, a 51,865 KB repository, created 2026-07-24 and last pushed 2026-09-07** (**⚠️ this metadata comes from the **search API** because the core API quota was exhausted this round**); ⭐ **licence measured as **Apache-2.0** with `LICENSE` measurably present** (**an uncommon case of a complete licence in this session**); **the repository measures 264 entries in total**. **Its self-description reads verbatim**: **"A commercial-grade **digital twin** of a French car insurance company operated by a CEO assisted by a **fleet of autonomous AI agents** — with **mandatory human control, full cryptographic traceability, and compliance-oriented by design**."** It is the third of this round’s four takes on **every value must point back to its source**, **and the one whose provenance granularity is the action** — **it records not where a field or a cell came from but where each action came from**.

Verifiable details (**read from the README**): ⭐⭐⭐ **Its operating scale is described verbatim and concretely, including headcount, agent count and model** — **verbatim**: **"Assurance Toto simulates a **50-employee digital car insurer** run as a multi-agent organization:"**; **"A **CEO (human)** supervises via a **Nostr-based workspace (Buzz)** and a lean CEO cockpit."**; **"**8 business agents** (**sales, underwriting, claims & litigation, finance, support, marketing, compliance, orchestration**) execute workflows on a **local LLM (Ollama, `gemma4:e4b`)**."** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: **the division between a human CEO and eight agents is written as an organisation chart rather than as an assistant**; **a local model, consistent with its zero-paid-API claim**; **and compliance is one of the eight agents — modelled as a department with its own remit rather than as checks scattered elsewhere**. **② ⭐⭐⭐ Its governance mechanism is verbatim, and it is the entry’s core contribution to the theme** — **verbatim**: **"**Every action is a cryptographically signed event**; **every high-stakes decision (claim settlement above a threshold, pricing exceptions, kill-switch) requires explicit CEO approval.**"**; **"Full traceability via a **hash-chained append-only audit log** and an **end-to-end `correlation_id`**."** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: **every action is signed, so an action is identifiable**; **three classes of high-stakes decision are named — claim settlement above a threshold, pricing exceptions and the kill-switch — which map exactly onto the three most sensitive things in this field: paying, pricing and stopping**; **a hash-chained append-only audit log, the same mechanism as round 336’s [[blueeconomy-marine-insurance]]**; **and an end-to-end `correlation_id`, meaning a request passing through several agents and departments can still have all its actions strung back onto one line** ⭐⭐⭐ **the last matters most here: in a multi-agent system "who produced this result" is far harder to answer than in a single process, and a correlation_id is the mechanism that turns that question into an answerable one**. **③ ⭐⭐⭐ Its positioning statement is verbatim, and it negates two things in one paragraph** — **verbatim**: **" > ⚠️ **Honest positioning** : this is a **sandbox-ready, compliance-oriented demonstrator**. It is **not ACPR/RGPD-certified** and **does not process real personal data (100 % synthetic Faker data)**."** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: **it calls itself a demonstrator rather than a product**; **it states explicitly that it is neither ACPR nor GDPR certified — naming two concrete frameworks most relevant to French motor insurance**; **and it states that it processes no real personal data, using one hundred percent synthetic data** ⭐⭐⭐ **for students building agentic insurance applications, this paragraph is a positioning template: it conceals nothing about what it is and names the two thresholds most easily assumed to be met, denying both**. **④ ⭐⭐ Its commercial framing is also verbatim, but separates what it sells from what it is not** — **verbatim**: **"It is a **sellable demo** for French/EU auto insurers, brokers, insurtechs and transformation consultancies — designed to prove : reduced cost per claim, faster underwriting, shorter response time, **human control on high-risk decisions**, **sovereign self-hosted deployment**, and **zero paid API dependency**."** ⭐⭐ **two of the five things it sets out to prove are constraints rather than benefits** (**human control over high-risk decisions, sovereign self-hosted deployment**). **⑤ ⭐⭐ Its agent runtime is measurably structured**: **`agents/_runtime/` contains `Dockerfile`, `README.md`, `package-lock.json`, `package.json`, and under `src/` the files `bridge/client.ts`, `composition.ts`, `config.ts`, `db/client.ts`, `index.ts`, `llm/ollama.ts`, `logger.ts`, **`privacy/anonymize.ts`** and `runtime/agent.ts`** ⭐⭐ **Three things**: **`llm/ollama.ts`, so the model interface is written for local Ollama**; ⭐ **`privacy/anonymize.ts`, so anonymisation is a runtime module rather than a sentence** (**synthetic data is one layer and an anonymisation module is another**); **and `logger.ts` separated from `bridge/client.ts`** (**⚠️ no source was read, so these modules are not claimed to do what their names suggest**). **⑥ ⭐⭐ Its stack is verbatim as badges**: **TypeScript (marked Strict), Nostr (protocol), Buzz by Block (cockpit), Ollama (local model), PostgreSQL 16 and Docker Compose (deployment)** ⭐⭐ **Three things**: **TypeScript in strict mode**; **PostgreSQL 16, the same family as round 336’s [[blueeconomy-marine-insurance]] in putting invariants in the database layer**; **and Docker Compose with a local model, so sovereign self-hosting has a technical landing point**. **⑦ ⭐⭐ Two further badges must be noted plainly**: **"**Tests: 75**" (with an image URL of the form `img.shields.io/badge/tests-75%20green-…`) and **"**API: 0 paid dependency**"** ⭐⭐ **⚠️ the entry notes that "Tests: 75 green" is a **static badge**, so it measures nothing and shows green regardless of whether the tests pass** (**⚠️ its actual CI result was not checked, so the 75 tests are claimed neither to pass nor to fail**); ⭐ **the same class of problem as round 337’s [[inforsight]] "CI passing" badge** (**no inference is drawn about intent**). **⑧ ⭐⭐ The repository also measurably contains a CI workflow**: **`.github/workflows/ci.yml`** — ⭐ **so it does have CI configured; the problem with the badge is not the absence of CI but that the badge does not reflect it**. **⑨ ⭐ Readable with the site’s governance, open core-system and compliance-agent entries**: [[insurance-governance]], [[blueeconomy-marine-insurance]], [[titanium-insurance-core]], [[openimis]], [[quorumforge]], [[cloud-itonami-isic-6520]], [[claims-integrity-investigator]], [[insurance-ai-regulation-mcp]], [[acpr]] and [[institut-des-actuaires]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️⚠️ Its metadata source needs explaining**: **the core API quota was exhausted this round**, **so ★0, the licence (Apache-2.0), the language (TypeScript), the size (51,865 KB) and the created/pushed dates (2026-07-24 and 2026-09-07) come from the **search API****; **⚠️ its fork count and topics were **not obtained** (**an unverified item and not an absence of topics**); ⭐ **the README’s byte size was not measured** (**only its opening was read**), **so no README size is given**. **② ⚠️⚠️ Only the README’s opening and the beginnings of its "what is this", "AI-operated insurance organisation" and "human control and governance" sections were read** — ⭐ **its full README was not read through, nor any `docs/` content**; **so the entry is limited to those sections** — **this is the single most important thing to verify next for this entry**. **③ ⚠️⚠️ No source was read, no command was run and no cryptographic verification was performed** — **⚠️ so the four claims of signed actions, a hash-chained append-only audit log, an end-to-end correlation_id and CEO approval for three classes of high-stakes decision are recorded only as the README states them**; ⭐ **what this check measured is that the files and directories exist** (**`LICENSE`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, and `agents/_runtime/` with its nine source files including `privacy/anonymize.ts` and `llm/ollama.ts`**) — **⚠️ but a file existing does not mean the mechanism inside it is as documented**; ⭐ **in particular, whether its signing and hash chain are cryptographically correct or secure was not verified** (**the entry does not recommend anyone build a production system on it**). **④ ⚠️⚠️ Whether the eight agents really run, what permissions each holds and whether the kill-switch works were not verified**; **its Docker Compose was not run, its configuration was not read and no call was made**. **⑤ ⚠️⭐ The claim of one hundred percent synthetic Faker data was not verified** (**no data file or data-generation code was read**); ⭐ **and that bears directly on whether it can be demonstrated safely in public** (**no claim is made that the data really is all synthetic**). **⑥ ⚠️⭐ The converse of "not ACPR/GDPR certified" was not verified** — ⭐ **that is, the entry does not claim it *fails* any specific regulatory requirement** (**no ACPR or GDPR provision was consulted**);
